Kimi add and launch dialogs (demo throws "cannot open a terminal")
Tab-key focus order: WebKit default skips buttons on Tab; focus rings verified with programmatic focus after a key press

findings.title: In use now card breaks with a long account label: the e-mail wraps four characters per line and the "Saved as" text runs out of the card
findings.proposal: Let .current-copy take the free width (flex: 1) and give .current-state min-width: 0 with an ellipsis and a title holding the full label, or move the state under the identity line.

findings.title: Dark theme chart draws two groups in the same yellow, so the legend cannot tell "Alpha Web" from "personal"
findings.proposal: --chart-4 maps to --pc-link, which equals --pc-accent in dark; give the chart its own six-step palette per theme (or map chart-4 to a distinct hue) and check that every pair differs.

findings.title: Pool field pattern is an invalid regular expression in WebKit, so pool validation is silently off
findings.page: accounts (Add an API key dialog, Automatic switching dialog)
findings.proposal: Escape the hyphen for the v-flag pattern syntax ([a-z0-9_\-]+) and add a test that the pattern compiles with the v flag.

findings.title: "Who works where" table is wider than its panel at 1100 px; the last column ("Limits and errors") is cut with no visible scroll cue (macOS overlay scrollbars)
findings.proposal: Drop or merge a column (Sent and Received into one Tokens cell) so it fits at the window's minimum width, or add an edge fade that shows more content lies to the right.

findings.title: Chart axis labels scale with the SVG and render at about 6 px at 740 px (about 9.5 px at 1100)
findings.proposal: Size the viewBox to the rendered width (ResizeObserver) or draw the axis labels in HTML outside the SVG so they stay at 11 px.

findings.title: Light theme: the first chart series (gold) has 1.34:1 contrast against the panel, below the 3:1 non-text minimum
findings.proposal: In light use the readable gold-brown (--pc-link) or a darker gold for series 1 and keep the bright accent for dark only.

findings.title: Native selects in dialogs render 22 px tall next to 39 px inputs in the same form grid
findings.page: dialogs (Add an API key, Automatic switching, Set up agent)
findings.proposal: Give .field select appearance: none with a drawn chevron (or -webkit-appearance: menulist-button) so min-height, padding and border apply like inputs.

findings.title: Section heading size changes per page: 12 px on Accounts, 16 px on Groups, 22 px on Tokens, Agents, Activity, Statistics and About
findings.proposal: Pick one section level (for example 16 px semibold) for every page and keep 22 px only where a page has a single panel, so the same element looks the same everywhere.

findings.title: Seven button heights in use (28, 30, 34, 36, 38, 39 and 55 px); row actions, header actions, panel actions and the Kimi "Launch..." button all differ
findings.proposal: Reduce to two sizes (default 36 px, compact 30 px) and map every button class onto one of them.

findings.title: Segmented control (Enabled/Disabled, Tokens/Requests, repository filter) barely shows which side is on: light selected fill is 1.08:1 against the track, dark selected is darker than the track
findings.proposal: Use the gold selection language the rest of the app uses for "on" (accent-weak fill plus accent-text border) or a raised white/ink thumb with a clear border.

findings.title: Truncated text with no way to read it: the PassionCode.ai line on Organizations and long account labels are cut with an ellipsis and carry no title
findings.proposal: The override at style.css:470 never wins over nowrap at :232; let .org-card-title .row-sub wrap (white-space: normal), and set title on truncated labels.

findings.title: Tour card sits fixed bottom-right and covers the control it highlights (step 3 hides "Turn on for Claude Code" at 740 px)
findings.proposal: Place the card next to the target rectangle (above or below, whichever has room) and scroll the target into the visible area outside the card.

findings.title: Accounts page stacks five blocks (demo banner, terms notice, rule strip, In use now, automatic switching) before the first account; at 800 px the list starts near y 590 and at 740 px below the fold
findings.proposal: Fold the terms notice and the rule strip into one compact status line under the header, and let the dismissed terms notice stay gone.

findings.title: Notice components disagree: the terms notice is a bordered panel in 14 px, the active rule strip has the same padding but no background or border, the sign-in banner uses 12 px
findings.proposal: Give every notice one container (panel-2 fill, border, 12 to 13 px text) and vary only the tone colour.

findings.title: New group dialog opens with focus on Cancel, and its account list is a 320 px scroller inside an already scrolling dialog
findings.proposal: Focus the Group name field on open; drop the inner max-height so the dialog body is the only scroller.

findings.title: Set up agent dialog breaks commands mid-word ("<pro ject folder>") and pushes its actions below the viewport
findings.proposal: Use overflow-wrap: anywhere only as a fallback (word-break: normal) and keep the dialog footer sticky at the bottom of the scrolling dialog.

findings.title: Selected state uses three different visuals on one page: gold chip for the default agent, gold pill "Default", grey segmented thumb for Enabled; About uses real radios inside chips
findings.proposal: Define one "chosen" token pair (accent-weak fill, accent-text border, check mark) and apply it to chips, pills and segments alike.

findings.title: Light hover states are nearly invisible: nav hover is white on #f7f5f8 (1.08:1) and buttons get lighter, not darker, on hover
findings.proposal: In light, hover to a slightly darker tint (for example color-mix of ink 6 percent into panel) instead of panel-raised white.

findings.title: Navigation icons are mixed Unicode glyphs with uneven size and weight (diamond and circle large, wave and plug tiny)
findings.proposal: Replace them with one icon set drawn on a 16 px grid at one stroke weight (inline SVG).

findings.title: Groups nav badge counts active project rules in the gold notification style and stays when no group exists
findings.proposal: Use a neutral badge or move the rule count to the Project rules section, so a gold count does not read as unread items about groups.

findings.title: Duplicate primary actions and inconsistent labels: header "+ New organization" and empty-state "+ New organization" side by side; Groups header "+ New group" but empty state "New group"
findings.proposal: While the empty state shows, make the header action secondary or hide it, and use one label for both.

findings.title: Statistics tiles leave the fifth tile alone on a second row at 1100 px
findings.proposal: Use a fixed 5-column grid above about 900 px of content width, or merge "Per request" into the Tokens tile.

findings.title: "Limits and errors" cells are warning-coloured for any non-zero count, including under 1 percent, so every row looks alarming
findings.proposal: Colour only rows above a threshold (for example 1 percent or any 429 burst) and keep the rest muted.

findings.title: Dialogs and menus appear and disappear with no transition; only the tour outline and group tip animate
findings.proposal: Add a 120 to 180 ms fade and 4 px rise on dialog[open] and .menu using the existing --dur-state token, disabled under reduced motion.

findings.title: Kimi Code footer buttons sit flush against the account card with no gap
findings.proposal: Give .management-actions a top margin of --space-3 when it follows a list.

findings.title: Non-clickable paths and commands use the link colour (gold-brown in light, gold in dark), so they read as links
findings.proposal: Keep --link for real links only and render paths and commands in --ink or --muted mono.

findings.title: Row menu puts the destructive "Remove..." directly under ordinary items with no separator
findings.proposal: Add a divider before destructive items in .menu.

findings.title: Group names carry a dotted underline (tooltip hint) and look like links
findings.proposal: Show the hint through an info icon or on hover only; keep the title plain.

findings.title: At 820 px and below the header actions stack into two full-width buttons and the sidebar version line wraps; "Pause countdown" drops onto its own line
findings.proposal: Keep header actions in a row (wrap only below 590 px), and let the version line ellipsize.

findings.title: Token drift in CSS: --font-mono is used but never defined (falls back), and .current-card is declared twice
findings.proposal: Use var(--font-data) and merge the two .current-card rules.

findings.title: Demo fixture says "Version 0.6.0 is the latest" while the sidebar shows v0.6.80
findings.proposal: Read the version from package.json in the demo update fixture.
